what_this_lane_delivers.capability: Every Command Center settlement and correction now collects an operator grading attestation and sends it to the API as operatorGradingContext, so a Smart Form Track Only pick can actually be settled manually.
what_this_lane_delivers.what_it_deliberately_does_not_do: It changes no API, no domain rule and no database. The server-side contract it satisfies (apps/api/src/settlement-service.ts:518, OPERATOR_GRADING_CONTEXT_REQUIRED) is unchanged by this lane; this lane stops the client violating it.
what_this_lane_delivers.why_that_split: The refusal at settlement-service.ts:518 is correct and was landed deliberately by UTV2-1861. The defect was entirely on the client: settlePick sent six fields and never the attestation, so manual settlement of an evidence-plane pick could not succeed at all.

control_sensitivity.control: apps/command-center/src/lib/server-action-guard.test.ts — 'the authenticated forged-actor cases actually reach the backend'
control_sensitivity.method: Measured rather than asserted: with settlePick invoked on two arguments the control failed (not ok 345, 523/524 passing), and it passes at this anchor with a valid attestation supplied as the third argument.
control_sensitivity.why_it_matters: settlePick now refuses an incomplete attestation. Without updating the call the guard suite would have gone vacuous — the forged-actor case would never have reached fetch, and the refusal under test would have silently become the attestation refusal rather than the authentication refusal it names.

runtime_proof_disposition.why: No runtime proof is claimed and none is owed at T2. This lane writes nothing to any database and adds no migration; the behaviour it repairs is asserted against the canonical validateOperatorGradingContext imported from @unit-talk/contracts rather than against a live API. The live assertion belongs to the Chiefs production E2E, which follows deployment of the Command Center and is tracked on its own merits.
runtime_proof_disposition.profile_note: proof_profile is static because this bundle carries static proof only. Authoring app-runtime would oblige non-empty runtime_proof.queries and runtime_proof.row_counts, and this lane has no live queries or row counts to record — fabricating them to satisfy a profile field is exactly what this bundle refuses to do.
